Name: Gigi's and Finnsinn's portraits edits (adding new characters with animal characteristics)
Author: shimanoaaron
Description:
I am not the original creator of these portraits. I simply edited them to add more characters with animal characteristics. The original creators are listed below. Please encourage them. Thank you. ( ' ')b

"Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits mod for All Characters" includes portraits of most Stardew Valley characters, without animal characteristics. 
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759

Finnsinn's "Abigail Catgirl Anime Portrait" & "Anime Catboy Portrait Mod" includes portraits of Abigail (Cat), Alex (Dog), Demetrius (Cat), Elliott (Bunny), Harvey (Cat), Sam (Bunny), Sebastian (Cat), Shane (Cat), and Wizard (Cat), with animal characteristics. 
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5481
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5487

I also have another mod "RRRR Wizard Catboy 32 Portraits" which also includes the Wizard (Cat), with animal characteristics. 
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21786

This mod right here includes Caroline (Cat), Emily (Bird), Evelyn (Dog), Gus (Bear), Haley (Bird), Jass (Cat), Jodi (Bunny), Leah (Bear), Marnie (Cat), Maru & Maru Hospital (Cat), Penny (Bunny), Sam (Bunny), Vincent (Bunny), Willy (Fish), and SVE Sophia (Cat), with animal characteristics.
[Note: There are more portraits in the downloadable file than you can see in the header and sample image.]
